summary: Generic EffectEnvelope contract is implemented as security_execution::effect_envelope. It represents each side-effecting Agent step from Draft through Prepared, Observed, Verified, Sealed, RollbackPending, RolledBack, or FailedClosed; binds lifecycle transitions to AuditJournal events; requires successful verification before CommitSealed; routes failed write-with-diff verification to RollbackPending; and rejects secret-like serialized values.

acceptance.criterion: Every side-effecting Agent step can be represented by an EffectEnvelope.
acceptance.evidence: EffectEnvelope stores run_id, step_id, tool, normalized_params, policy_decision, lease, sandbox_profile, prepared_event, observed_event, verification_result, rollback_handle, commit_id, and state.

acceptance.criterion: EffectPrepared must precede EffectObserved for any observed effect.
acceptance.evidence: security_execution::effect_envelope::tests::rejects_observed_before_prepared rejects observe from Draft, while side_effecting_restart_moves_from_prepare_to_seal confirms prepared < observed < sealed in AuditJournal.

acceptance.criterion: CommitSealed requires a successful verification result.
acceptance.evidence: security_execution::effect_envelope::tests::rejects_commit_sealed_without_successful_verification rejects seal before Verified and confirms failed verification does not emit CommitSealed.

acceptance.criterion: RollbackPending cannot be skipped for failed write-with-diff verification.
acceptance.evidence: security_execution::effect_envelope::tests::failed_write_with_diff_verification_enters_rollback_pending asserts failed fs.write.diff verification enters RollbackPending, emits RollbackPending, rejects seal, and rejects fail_closed skip.
security_execution::effect_envelope::tests::serialization_rejects_secret_values_but_allows_secret_handles rejects raw token/password values and allows secret:// handles.

effect_envelope_contract.secret_policy: Reject raw secret-like values; allow secret:// handles only.
